decisions.reason: It remained promoted on its own page into 2024 and, for a large established software firm, an inbound SMS API is a reusable platform feature that is relatively cheap to maintain and fits broader messaging and integration offerings.

Although newly launched in 2024 and therefore less proven, an email-to-SMS gateway is a natural adjacent capability in an enterprise communications portfolio and is likely to be retained while the firm tests adoption.
As a newly launched companion product to the firm's messaging tools, an SMS-to-email gateway is strategically complementary and likely to stay on the market unless early demand is clearly weak.
